appName.description:
Optional, name of the app to render type documentation in.
If not specified, uses the current app.

typeName.description:
Name of the type to render.
Applicable only for {@link DocumentationKind} enums related to a type.

fieldName.description: Applicable only if kind is {@link DocumentationKind.FIELD}.

methodName.description: Applicable only if kind is {@link DocumentationKind.METHOD}.

privateFields.description: Whether to show private fields and methods.
